_comment: Car damage (POLISH card), used when the race setup's Damage setting is Visual (shown, no effect) or Realistic (it costs). A hit's closing speed along the contact normal (m/s) over thresholdMps does damage: (speed - threshold) x perMps x strength x wallMult / barrierMult / carMult, into the zone it landed on (nose -> front wing, tail -> rear wing, sides -> that side's suspension; endZone = how much of each half-length counts as nose/tail). Effects at full damage: frontGripLoss (understeer), rearGripLoss + rearDragLoss, sideGripLoss at that side's two wheels + pullDeg of steering pull toward it. No DNF: the car always keeps going. Pit repair while stopped in the box: a wing takes repair.wingSec whatever the damage, suspension up to repair.suspensionSec.
